Recreation anchors: Brandrith Park, 5093 12 Ave (pickleball, picnic tables, sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts, washrooms, per the City park search); South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 St; Tsawwassen Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 1321A 56 St, at Tsawwassen Town Centre.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Cliff Drive

items.t: Delta zoning — number CONTESTED, flagged as required: City of Delta pages cite Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017, while an internal title says "8400, 2025" — the collision is flagged here and neither number is asserted as settled. On the City pages as cited, Tsawwassen lots sit under the RS and RD zones assigned parcel by parcel, with subdivision minimums including RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550 m² (or 460 m² outside the Single Family Residential designation), RS6 at 390 m², RS7 at 335 m², RD1 at 836 m² and RD4 at 504 m², while RS1, RS2, RS3, RD2 and RD3 sit at 4,000 m².

Hazard Development Permit Area SD2: the OCP's hazard DPAs in Tsawwassen include SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment), immediately west of this pocket. Which specific Cliff Drive parcels fall inside SD2: UNVERIFIED — it is read parcel by parcel off the OCP DPA maps.

PTT: 1% on the first $200,000, 2% from $200,000 to $2 million, 3% above $2 million, plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3 million. Newly Built Home Exemption: full to $1,100,000, gone at $1,150,000.

blocks.text: Good to know about Cliff Drive

items.t: The sub-area name travels further in listings than the pocket does.

There is no Tsawwassen Area Plan to consult for this pocket. The former plan was Schedule D.1 under the superseded OCP Bylaw No. 3950; the current consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), contains no such schedule — plan references quoted from older material should be re-read against Bylaw 8400.
Brandrith Park is the pocket's park, at 5093 12 Ave — listed by the City with pickleball, picnic tables, sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts and washrooms.

The escarpment permit area starts at the pocket's western edge. SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment) is a hazard Development Permit Area under the OCP — a diligence item for the English Bluff Road side that listing copy does not flag.

The live Tsawwassen homes-under-$1.8M page surfaced a Cliff Drive–labelled detached card (1641 53a Street) in the batch-8 check — evidence the MLS sub-area label is in use for detached stock, not evidence of any condo product in the pocket.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Cliff Drive

items.t: Delta OCP: Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), "Housing Our Future," adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan, NO lettered schedules; farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)." There is NO Tsawwassen Area Plan schedule in Bylaw 8400 — the former Tsawwassen Area Plan was Schedule D.1 under the superseded OCP, Bylaw No. 3950, and citing "Schedule D.1 of Bylaw 8400" is an error wherever it is met.

Flood frame: the City of Delta is the diking authority and operates over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure.

PTT + exemptions, with the tier flag: general PTT is 1% on the first $200,000, 2% from $200,000 to $2,000,000 and 3% above $2,000,000, plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3,000,000 — a page row reading "Over $3M — 5%" is a compression of that 3% + 2%, not a separate rate, and worked examples must show the tier math. First-time buyers: exempt on the first $500,000 at fair market value $835,000 or less, partial to $860,000. Newly built home exemption: full to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Cliff Drive

items.t: Fee-simple lots are the only land form: The research records the typical stock as single detached houses under the RS zones around 12 Avenue and English Bluff Road, with duplex product under the RD zones where those zones apply, zoning assigned parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps. A Cliff Drive parcel is bought whole — house, lot and zone — not as a serviced lot in a subdivision product.

Lot sizes, only as the research states them: the subdivision minimums that frame new lots are RS4 at 610 m², RS5 at 550 m² (or 460 m² outside the Single Family Residential designation), RS6 at 390 m², RS7 at 335 m², RD1 at 836 m² and RD4 at 504 m², while RS1, RS2, RS3, RD2 and RD3 sit at 4,000 m². Existing lot sizes vary and are confirmed parcel by parcel; no typical or average lot size is published: UNCONFIRMED.

Named subdivisions / bare-land developments: none verified — count 0: Assemblies, development sites and proposals, where a seller promotes one, are documented AS SUCH, never as inventory — none is documented for this pocket in the research.

Bare-land strata: none verified — count 0: The stock confirmed on official sources is freehold houses and duplexes; any strata product in the narrow pocket is UNVERIFIED. The Garden Place NWS1841 units are built strata, not bare-land strata, and sit outside the pocket as defined — see the OPEN flag at the top.
: No presale lot offering in Cliff Drive is documented in the research.
ALR vs non-ALR split: A specific parcel's ALR status is checked in the ALC's ALR Property and Map Finder and on title.

Hazard edge: the OCP's hazard Development Permit Areas in Tsawwassen include SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment), immediately west of this pocket. Which specific Cliff Drive parcels fall inside SD2: UNVERIFIED — read parcel by parcel off the OCP DPA maps before pricing any western-edge lot.

Servicing: Parcel-level servicing and connection charges: UNCONFIRMED. The City is the diking authority and operates over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 km of drainage infrastructure.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Cliff Drive

items.t: Municipality: City of Delta, BC. Cliff Drive sits inside the Tsawwassen community — one of Delta's three communities (Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta), with Ladner and Tsawwassen together called South Delta — planned under the Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024).

The wider-definition question, stated once and left OPEN: secondary listing sources label units at 1440 / 1441 Garden Place ("The Camelia" / "Magnolia", strata plan NWS1841, built 1982) with the subdivision name Cliff Drive; those addresses sit by the town-centre / Winskill side of Tsawwassen, outside the narrow pocket above, and sources disagree on the assignment.

Schools are SD37 and address-based, K–7 elementary and 8–12 secondary with no middle-school tier. The recorded sample result for 1299 56 St — at the pocket's eastern edge, not binding the whole pocket — is Cliff Drive Elementary, 5025 12 Ave, and South Delta Secondary, 750 53 St. Catchments for other addresses: UNVERIFIED — run the exact address in the SD37 School Locator. Ministry-listed names only are used here: Cliff Drive Elementary; South Delta Secondary.

Anchors: Brandrith Park, 5093 12 Ave (pickleball, picnic tables, sport courts, sports fields, tennis courts, washrooms); South Delta Recreation Centre, 1720 56 St; Tsawwassen Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 1321A 56 St. Transit: route 601 South Delta / Boundary Bay to Bridgeport Station via 56 Street and South Delta Exchange (56 Street and 18 Avenue); route 602 Tsawwassen Heights to Bridgeport Station via the exchange. Driving times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Cliff Drive

items.t: OCP: Delta Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), "Housing Our Future", adopted July 8, 2024: — a single consolidated plan with NO lettered schedules. There is no Tsawwassen Area Plan in Bylaw 8400; the former Tsawwassen Area Plan was Schedule D.1 under the superseded OCP, Bylaw No. 3950 — any document citing "Schedule D.1 of Bylaw 8400" is in ERROR. Farm land in the plan is designated "Agriculture (A)".

Strata block — stated for completeness, governing no verified Cliff Drive land stock: if a bare-land strata lot were ever the purchase (none is verified here), the BC block would apply to the LOT — Form B (Strata Property Act s. 59) within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page, with fees, CRF balance, levies, insurance summary, rules, budget and depreciation report; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Reg 7.01, May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid age bylaw.

Market context: none stated — South Delta / Tsawwassen is NOT SnapStats-covered, North Delta figures are never substituted, and SnapStats has no land category (Detached vs "Condos & Townhomes" combined only) in any case.

blocks.text: Good to know about Cliff Drive

items.t: The name itself is the first trap.

The anchor school sits inside the pocket; the sample catchment sits at its edge. Cliff Drive Elementary is physically at 5025 12 Ave, but the only recorded locator sample is 1299 56 St at the eastern edge — do not market a western-edge lot as "in the Cliff Drive Elementary catchment" without its own locator run.

The escarpment is immediately west, not inside the sales pitch. SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment) is the OCP's hazard DPA for the shore west of this pocket; which Cliff Drive parcels fall inside it is a map read, not a neighbourhood assumption.
The research documents the identity defect itself: the live positioning rests on a sub-area name with no official boundary (above).
The intentionally deleted tsawwassen-mobile-homes page returning 404 is expected and is not a defect.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Are there any condos in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: None verified. The batch-8 research found no condo or townhome complex name with a street address in this pocket on an official, developer, strata or manager source; the confirmed stock is freehold detached houses and duplexes under the RS/RD zones. A buyer set on strata product is, in practice, shopping the neighbouring sub-areas' documented buildings — which are filed under those sub-areas, not this one.

faq.q: Is Cliff Drive an official neighbourhood I can rely on in an offer?
faq.a: Describe a property by street, zone and address-based catchment.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Cliff Drive home?
faq.a: SD37, address-based, K–7 elementary and 8–12 secondary with no middle tier. The recorded sample (1299 56 St) gives Cliff Drive Elementary, 5025 12 Ave, and South Delta Secondary, 750 53 St; run any other address in the locator.

faq.q: Can a detached Cliff Drive home add units?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH updates allow up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots where the zoning applies — a parcel-level City check, and the actual density route in a pocket with no condo buildings.

faq.q: What hazard check matters on the pocket's west edge?
faq.a: Whether the parcel falls inside hazard Development Permit Area SD2 English Bluff (Tsawwassen Escarpment), read parcel by parcel off the OCP DPA maps before subjects come off.

faq.q: Are there any townhouses in Cliff Drive?
faq.a: None verified. A buyer set on townhouse product is, in practice, shopping the neighbouring sub-areas' documented complexes — filed under those sub-areas, not this one.

faq.q: A listing calls a Garden Place unit "Cliff Drive" — is it a townhouse, and is it in this pocket?
faq.a: It is an apartment condo, not a townhouse: listings record Apartment/Condo, Freehold Strata, plan NWS1841, built 1982 (Magnolia / The Camelia at Garden Place). Built form governs over the feed label in either case.
